soracloud.title: SoraCloud control plane

accessBoundary.title: SoraCloud separates public service discovery from account-scoped reads
accessBoundary.discoveryDescription: Torii exposes the two service-discovery routes without account authentication. Status, application, compliance, model, lease, and agent reads require canonical account authentication.
accessBoundary.protectedDescription: This public Explorer does not issue unsigned requests to protected routes, embed account keys, or reinterpret an authorization failure as an empty result. An authenticated workspace must bind protected requests to the connected account and exact {networkId}.

accessBoundary.title: Governance requires canonical request authentication
accessBoundary.protectedReads: Torii protects every {governanceRoutes} read. The public Explorer does not issue unsigned governance requests and does not retry them anonymously.
accessBoundary.capabilities: An authenticated governance workspace can inspect network readiness and the supported governance routes through {capabilitiesRoute}. That response is not a caller-grant list; every request still uses exactly one of Torii's two canonical authentication forms.
accessBoundary.multisigWitnessDescription: Send {witnessHeader}, optionally with a matching {accountHeader}. A witness must not be combined with {signatureHeader}, {timestampHeader}, or {nonceHeader}.
accessBoundary.contractDescription: Parliament attempts and transitions, citizens, referenda, locks, tallies, proposals, and event streams are available only after canonical request authentication succeeds. Capability discovery reports the network contract and readiness; it does not authorize the caller.
